'''Andy Chen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th at [[2000 Alderaan Regionals]] on 29 July 2000, according to Ryan Schueller's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1063">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-alderaan-regional-7-29-2kd1063/ alderaan-regional-7-29-2k], DeckTech (Ryan "Mage" Schueller, 30 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-alderaan-regional-7-29-2kd1063/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
